blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `ensureSuperAdminRemainsStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step ensures that at least one user keeps the unscoped super admin role
once the given role assignments are removed, so that no operation can lock
every user out of the RBAC administration.

It's a no-op when RBAC is not installed.

children.name: excluded_assignment_ids
children.description: The IDs of the role assignments about to be removed.
